title: Armored Figure with Quill
description: A large, overweight man in ornate dark metal armor and helmet sits on a massive burning book. He holds a large quill in one hand and a shield covered in heraldic symbols in the other, with an open book resting on his lap. The background is a swirling purple vortex filled with floating text and a hanging scale labeled 'JUSTICE' dripping red liquid.
prompt: A massive overweight knight in ornate dark metal armor with gold details and a helmet sits heavily on a giant burning book. He holds a large white quill poised over an open book on his lap and carries a shield with heraldic crests. His armor has text reading PLOT ARMOR and 1000. In the swirling purple vortex background is a golden scale labeled JUSTICE dripping blood, with floating text and feathers, dramatic fantasy style, highly detailed digital painting.
